When we first saw the setup at the entrance, we didn’t expect much—it looked like a simple, standard arrangement. There are many such mystery rooms in the market that feel very basic and even childish. But once we got started, this experience turned out to be amazing and completely unexpected!

The level of mystery, suspense, and thrill was incredible. It’s a fantastic place to hang out with a group of friends and have an exciting time.e
Especially the mystery and horror ones, were absolutely mind-blowing.

The entire team, including the live actors inside the rooms, did an exceptional job. The setup is absolutely mind-blowing, and nothing prepares you for what’s coming next. It’s intense, thrilling, and genuinely scary—perfect for an unforgettable adventure. This is a one-of-a-kind experience that I’d 110% recommend to anyone looking for something unique and exciting!

We had an amazing time and can’t wait to try out all the levels available. Highly recommended for anyone looking for a thrilling and engaging experience!

Mystery Rooms – 2.5/5
The ring
Overall, it was okay, but a bit disappointing.
There was no proper video introduction, so the story wasn’t clear. The room was too dark and had no proper directions, which made it confusing.
The setup was actually very good, but the experience didn’t match up. The walkie-talkie voice was annoying and not helpful. Some clues seemed already disturbed, and the rooms weren’t labeled properly.
The live actor was a good part of the experience.

There are moments in life when your mind feels trapped in an endless loop of thoughts… when problems don’t just stay outside, they follow you everywhere. That’s exactly where we were... when we decided to try the Kohinoor room at Mystery Room, Andheri West..
and honestly, we didn’t realize then how much we needed it.
From the moment we entered, the energy shifted. The staff welcomed us with such warmth..always smiling, patient, and genuinely excited for us. It didn’t feel like just another activity; it felt like someone quietly telling us, “You’re going to feel better here.”
And then the game began.
What I loved the most was how brilliantly the clues were designed...hilarious, clever, and surprisingly nostalgic.. It was a reminder ...It felt like everything I had ever studied, observed, or casually learned in life was suddenly coming together. Each puzzle wasn’t just a task...it was a spark. A distraction. A reminder that the mind can still play, think, and solve… even when it feels heavy.
There were moments we laughed uncontrollably...cant tell you d exact details , moments we got stuck, and moments where we just looked at each other and said, “Wait… could it be this?” And when things started clicking, it wasn’t just about solving the room...it felt like breaking through something inside us. We dint panic ,got angry, or blamed each other but were focused on problem solving..
And then… that bell rang.
That sound ..it wasn’t just a signal that we had completed the task in hand... It was a jolt.... The exact jolt we didn’t know we needed... For those few minutes, we weren’t thinking about stress, worries, or anything weighing us down. We were just present, quick..and connected... We dint think ... We just did what needed to be done ..and laughed out our hearts....
We walked out lighter. Clearer. Almost reset.
If you’re feeling stuck, overwhelmed, or just mentally exhausted, this place is more than just an escape room. It’s a pause. A shift. A small but powerful break from the chaos inside your head.
For me and my sister, it wasn’t just an experience...it was a moment of healing.
A must-visit. Truly one of the best experiences we’ve ever had.

featured_reviews.name: Dr Hrishikesh Doke
featured_reviews.review_text:
We recently visited this kids' play zone and found that while the facilities are good, there are some areas that need improvement to enhance the overall experience and safety of children.

1. Overcrowding: The play area was extremely crowded in peak hours, making it difficult for children to enjoy the activities comfortably and safely. Limiting the number of visitors during peak hours or introducing timed slots could help.

2. Insufficient Care Staff: There appeared to be too few staff members supervising the play area. Additional attendants would help monitor children's safety, manage activities better, and assist parents when needed.

3. Parents Inside the Play Area: Many parents were sitting within the play zone itself, creating obstructions and reducing the available space for children to play freely.

Suggestions for Improvement:

- Implement a maximum occupancy limit.
- Increase the number of trained care staff during busy hours.
- Prepare guidelines for kids as well as parents.
- Regularly monitor crowd levels to ensure a safe and enjoyable environment.

With these improvements, the play zone can provide a much better experience for both children and parents.

featured_reviews.name: Shambhavi Paradkar
featured_reviews.review_text:
We recently celebrated our daughter’s birthday at Funkey Monkey Playzone, and we are extremely happy with the entire experience. It was a well-managed and memorable event – truly paisa vasool!

Food:
The food arrangement was excellent – delicious, kid-friendly, and perfectly suited for the occasion. Many of our guests specifically complimented the taste and quality. We were also pleasantly surprised when the team offered us an additional main course dish complimentary, staying well within the agreed budget. A lovely gesture!

Decoration:
The decoration exceeded our expectations. The team went above and beyond by adding a few beautiful elements on their own, which weren’t part of the original plan. The combination of pastel shades looked elegant and festive. We really appreciate the extra effort!

Funkey Monkey Team:
A big shoutout to Samina and Neha, who were incredibly supportive and attentive throughout the planning and during the event. They ensured everything went smoothly and were always available when needed.

Play Area & Tattoo Artist:
The play area was a hit – not just for the kids, but for many of the adults too! The tattoo artist was a great addition, and even grown-ups joined in the fun. It really added to the lively and playful atmosphere.

Suggestions for Improvement:

It would be great if the food could be kept warm till the end of the party, as it was a bit cold by the time guests were eating.

The washroom area felt quite hot, which made it a bit uncomfortable while changing kids' clothes. Some ventilation or cooling would help.

Despite the couple of minor points, the entire experience was fantastic. Thank you so much to the entire Funkey Monkey team for making our daughter’s birthday so special. We highly recommend this venue for kids' parties and celebrations!

featured_reviews.review_text:

featured_reviews.name: Jannat Sorathia
featured_reviews.review_text:
I visited this place on a recommendation with my cousin’s kids and honestly it turned out to be such a fun and memorable experience. The moment you enter you’re welcomed by different animal structures and statues, the entire space is beautifully designed with a jungle theme. Every corner looks vibrant and thoughtfully created, making it perfect for kids who love animals.

What really stood out to me was the mix of fun and learning. They have interactive setups like a bank counter, kitchen area, shopping mall and even a doctor’s clinic, which makes it engaging for kids while also being educational. There are plenty of activities to keep them busy along with cute rides and play areas.

The highlight has to be the crazy maze castle, it’s honestly something you need to experience to understand how exciting it is. I genuinely felt like I wish I was a kid again to enjoy it fully, even adults can have a great time here watching and being part of the fun.

Another thing I really appreciated is how many staff members are always around. They are very attentive and make sure the kids are safe and enjoying at all times. Even if you’re busy or just want to relax for a bit, you can trust them to take good care of your kids. It definitely feels like a very safe and well-managed environment.

They also have a very cute café serving pure vegetarian food. We tried pizza, pasta, fries, boba drinks and coffee, everything was quite good and perfect after all the activities.

I also got to know that the place can be booked for kids’ birthday parties and celebrations, which honestly makes it even more special.

Overall it’s truly a unique experience and definitely one of Mumbai’s first jungle adventure themed parks. I would highly recommend this place to anyone with kids, it’s something they’re going to absolutely love
